escena: SCENE: a still from a modern, cinematic corporate comedy sketch, photorealistic. In the same brand-new contemporary meeting room on a high floor of a modern office tower in Santiago de Chile: floor-to-ceiling frameless glass walls, a long pale oak meeting table with a thin matte black steel base, modern upholstered chairs in warm grey, a large frameless wall display, linear recessed LED ceiling lights, polished concrete floor, one sculptural green plant; through the glass the Santiago skyline and the Andes. Current-generation hardware only (thin aluminum laptops, frameless screens), clean surfaces; nothing dated, no paper stacks, no books, no old monitors, nothing worn, out of focus behind her. Paula in medium close-up, 85mm f/2.8: one eyebrow raised, half-laughing in disbelief, head tilted, hands open on the table, asking an almost sarcastic question, looking toward someone off-frame to the right. Light: soft, flat, cool overcast daylight from the windows under a flat grey sky, neutral and slightly grey, muted colors, calm and corporate — a modern office on a dull day, never fluorescent, never dirty.
